limits: Three runs on one environment, not a population performance guarantee.
CPU median and P99 are descriptive within 256 correlated operation bundles; independent units are process repeats.
CPU timing includes evict, add, reuse, touch, remove and re-add; initialization is separately measured under tracemalloc.
Tracemalloc is Python allocation, not full process RSS; heap memory and compaction costs are retained.
CUDA Event times exclude Python validation/dispatch and do not measure serving TPOT.
All policy requests are synthetic barriers; no HTTP/quality/SLO or final-test conclusion.
Fixed candidate auto cutoff32 is not claimed globally optimal; all ablations retained including regressions.
